This plan costs 240 minutes in total. That is 180 minutes of driving plus 60 for the three deferred adults.

- **Deferred:** The adults at Trishuli farm and Bidur farm are cut off. The only road out of that cluster, Tarkeshwar care home to Suryagadhi temple, is damaged, so these 3 adults are deferred (3 × 20 = 60).
- **Everyone else:** Rescuing them costs less than deferring them. Driving time is the only cost, so the trips are planned to minimise total driving.
